title: David Lynch
subtitle: the features, in release order
blurb: Nine features and all of Twin Peaks as one row — about 63 hours, most of it one town in Washington.
notes: Twin Peaks is one row here.

Both seasons, Fire Walk with Me and The Return are tracked on their own page, woven with the books — this list just carries a single box for the whole town, so working through Lynch means one tick, not thirty. It weighs its real size though, which is why it owns most of the bar.
The shorts, the music videos, the commercials, On the Air, Hotel Room, and the web series — Rabbits ended up largely inside Inland Empire anyway. This is the features.
From Wikidata, in hours. The Twin Peaks row is sized as the whole run — roughly 44 hours — because pretending it is one film would make the pacing a lie.
Filmography from Wikipedia; runtimes from Wikidata.

sections.title: Before the Red Room
sections.intro: Five years in a garage making Eraserhead, then the strangest studio career anyone has had: an Oscar-nominated period drama, the most expensive science-fiction film ever made to that point, and Blue Velvet.
